title: Irish Pea Stew
description: A hearty and comforting French-inspired stew made with tender Irish stew beef, fresh peas, and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Brown the Irish stew beef in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the butter, peas, beef broth, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
